description: Source code for OpenSSL's X.509 v3 name constraints handling, including parsing, matching, and validation functions.

classes.name: GENERAL_SUBTREE
classes.description: Represents a General Subtree in name constraints, including base name and optional min/max constraints.

classes.name: NAME_CONSTRAINTS
classes.description: Represents name constraints with permitted and excluded subtrees.

methods.name: v2i_NAME_CONSTRAINTS
methods.description: Parses configuration values into NAME_CONSTRAINTS structure.

methods.name: do_i2r_name_constraints
methods.description: Helper for serializing individual name constraints.

methods.name: NAME_CONSTRAINTS_check
methods.description: Checks if a certificate complies with specified name constraints.

methods.name: nc_match
methods.description: Matches a General Name against permitted and excluded subtrees.

methods.name: nc_match_single
methods.description: Matches a General Name against a single constraint base.

methods.name: nc_dn
methods.description: Checks if a directory name matches a name constraint.

methods.name: nc_dns
methods.description: Checks if a DNS name matches a constraint.

methods.name: nc_email
methods.description: Checks if an email name matches a constraint.

methods.name: nc_uri
methods.description: Checks if a URI matches a constraint.
